What is included

Built for how patients choose a practice.

Google Business Profile careAccurate hours, locations, providers, services and photos, checked by a person and kept current across every location.
Reviews, handled carefullyA steady way to ask for reviews and replies written so they never confirm that someone is a patient or discuss their care.
Service and provider pagesClear pages for the services, conditions and providers patients search for, written so search engines and AI assistants can read them.
Search and AI visibility trackingRegular checks of how your practice appears for the searches that matter in your area, compared with nearby practices.
How we start

From first call to first report.

01 Visibility checkWe search the way your patients do, on Google Search, Google Maps and AI assistants, and record where you show up and where competitors do instead.
02 PlanYou get a written plan that lists the gaps in order of impact, what we will do about each one, and what we will not touch.
03 ReportingWe report against the baseline from the visibility check, in plain language, so you can see what moved and what did not.
Do you write medical advice or clinical content?

No. We write about your practice, services, providers and how to book. Clinical statements come from your team, and we ask a clinician to approve them before anything is published.

How do you handle patient privacy in reviews?

Replies stay general. We do not confirm that a reviewer is a patient or mention any care details, and we flag reviews that need a response from your office instead.

Can you work with multiple locations?

Yes. Each location gets its own profile checks and reporting, with one plan across the group.
